UP PGT Interview Letter 2026

Post Date: June 6, 2026

10:21 am

Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the Interview Letter on its official website for the UP PGT examination. The UPSESSB PGT interview will be conducted on 15 – 27 June 2026. The last date to submit the application form was 16 July 2022. Candidates can check their Interview Letter by logging into the portal using their enrollment number, registration number, or date of birth. The official link is provided below. (Advt No. : 01/2022 & 02/2022)

 How To Check & Download UP PGT Interview Letter 2026 
  • Visit the official website of
    Uttar Pradesh Secondary Education Service Selection Board
  • On the homepage, click on
    “PGT Exam Interview Letter 2026”
  • You will be redirected to the login page
  • Enter your details:
    • Registration Number
    • Date of Birth
    • Captcha Code
  • Click on Login / Submit
  • Your Interview Letter will appear on the screen
  • Download or take a printout

 UP PGT Interview Letter 2026 : Important Question 
  • Question: When will the Interview Letter be released?
  • Answer: The interview letter is released after the result on the official website of the Uttar Pradesh Secondary Education Service Selection Board.
  • Question: Where can I check the interview letter?
  • Answer: You can check it online from the official website under the interview letter section.
  • Question: Is the exam city slip the same as the admit card?
  • Answer: No, the exam city slip only shows the exam city and tentative date, not full exam details.
  • Question: Why is the exam city slip released?
  • Answer: It helps candidates to plan travel and accommodation in advance.
  • Question: What is the official website Of UPESSC?
  • Answer: The official website Of UPESSC is https://www.upessc.up.gov.in/
